TechnicalResources.metaTitle: Technical resources: EVEREST test reports and EPDs
TechnicalResources.metaDescription: IRCCOS test reports, thermal calculations, environmental declarations and certifications for EVEREST aluminium and PVC systems, by series, with language and format.
TechnicalResources.title: Technical resources
TechnicalResources.intro: EVEREST test reports, thermal calculations and declarations, by series.

testReport.title: Laboratory test reports
testReport.description: IRCCOS laboratory reports on one named window or door sample: air permeability, watertightness and resistance to wind load. The classes apply to the tested sample.

thermalCalculation.title: Thermal calculations
thermalCalculation.description: Calculations of frame thermal transmittance Uf to EN ISO 10077-2:2017 for specific frame nodes. The value is for the node calculated, not for a complete window.

environmentalDeclaration.title: Environmental declarations (EPD)
environmentalDeclaration.description: Environmental Product Declarations (EPD) to ISO 14025 and EN 15804, registered with the International EPD System. They describe environmental impact per 1 kg of profile, not window performance.

certification.title: Certifications
certification.description: Certifications issued by independent bodies. Each names its own holder and scope. None is an AL STORE certificate.

drawing.title: Technical drawings
drawing.description: Technical drawings of profiles and nodes.

reading.sample: Laboratory results belong to the sample or node named in the report. They are not certificates of conformity and do not apply to a whole series or to the aluminium or PVC category.
reading.complete: IRCCOS reports are published complete and unaltered, as the laboratory permits. Environmental declarations and certifications open from the official sources that issued them.
reading.official: The “Official EVEREST document” label means the document itself names EVEREST as applicant, owner, holder or manufacturer. The issuer is shown separately.
reading.manufacturer: Manufacturer references such as EV HYBRID are kept apart: AL STORE does not sell them and does not accept quotation requests for them.

TechnicalResources.summary: {documents} documents from {issuers} independent issuers · complete, unaltered PDFs

Documents.sampleLimit: These results belong to the tested sample named above. They are not a certificate of conformity and they do not apply to the whole series or category.
Documents.productStandard: Normative reference on the report: EN 14351-1:2006+A2:2016.

rp2147.title: Test report 1994-CPR-RP2147
rp2147.specimen: Double-casement aluminium window, main casement tilt-and-turn, trade name 70000. Declared size 1 447 mm × 1 650 mm. Double glazing 4 mm / 20 mm cavity / 33.1 mm.

rp2146.title: Test report 1994-CPR-RP2146
rp2146.specimen: Double-casement aluminium window, main casement tilt-and-turn, trade name 71000. Declared size 1 447 mm × 1 650 mm. Double glazing 4 mm / 36 mm cavity / 33.1 mm.

rp2790.title: Test report 1994-CPR-RP2790
rp2790.specimen: One frame node for aluminium casement windows, trade name 71 000: the lateral / lower / upper node. Profiles 71101 and 71281. Triple glazing, 48 mm.
rp2790.conditions: EN ISO 10077-2:2017, radiosity method. Inside 20 °C, outside 0 °C. The value is for this node.

rp2157.title: Test report 1994-CPR-RP2157
rp2157.specimen: Double-casement sliding door, trade name PB2AAR_EVEREST_91000, laboratory code PF2ASA_EVEREST_91000. Declared profiles include 91106, 91202, 91204 and 91501. Declared size 2 000 mm × 2 400 mm. Double glazing 4 mm / 16 mm cavity / 4 mm.

rp2144.title: Test report 1994-CPR-RP2144
rp2144.specimen: Lift-and-slide door with central reinforcement, trade name 92000, double symmetrical sash. The report cover describes the specimen as a 300 kg door. Declared size 2 570 mm × 2 450 mm. Double glazing 4 mm / 18 mm cavity / 33.1 mm.

rp2145.title: Test report 1994-CPR-RP2145
rp2145.specimen: Lift-and-slide door without central reinforcement, trade name 92000, double symmetrical sash. The report cover describes the specimen as a 300 kg door. Declared size 2 570 mm × 2 450 mm. Double glazing 4 mm / 18 mm cavity / 33.1 mm.

epd26335.title: Environmental declaration EPD-IES-0026335
epd26335.covered: Representative product: profile 71 000. Other profiles named in the declaration: 92 000, 93 000, CE 32 000, E50 and E34. Declared unit: 1 kg. Prepared to ISO 14025:2006 and EN 15804:2012+A2:2019/AC:2021. Listing a profile here does not give it the laboratory classes above and does not add it as a separate product.

rp2176.title: Test report 1994-CPR-RP2176
rp2176.specimen: Double-casement PVC window, main casement tilt-and-turn, trade name PVC 85000. Declared size 1 447 mm × 1 650 mm. Double glazing 4 mm / 12 mm cavity / 4 mm.

rp2549.title: Test report 1994-CPR-RP2549
rp2549.specimen: Three PVC window nodes, trade name 76000, as named in the report. Profiles include frame 76103 and sash 76401. Triple glazing, 43 mm in total.
rp2549.uf: 1.2 W/(m²K) for node 01 (frame–sash), node 02 (frame–sash) and node 03 (sash meeting)
rp2549.conditions: EN ISO 10077-2:2017, radiosity method. Each node was calculated separately.

asi554.title: ASI Performance Standard, certificate 554
asi554.scope: Performance Standard V3.1, full certification, certificate 554. Holder: Everest Shpk, Kamez, Albania. Scope: manufacture of aluminium billets, architectural and industrial profiles, powder-coated profiles and fenestration products, including doors, windows and façade systems. This certifies the manufacturer, not one product series and not AL STORE.

epd26336.title: Environmental declaration EPD-IES-0026336
epd26336.scope: Environmental declaration of one product: hybrid aluminium/PVC profile 67 000. Declared unit: 1 kg. ISO 14025:2006 and EN 15804:2012+A2:2019/AC:2021. The declaration states, for this profile, efficiency class phB (Passive House), class C4 (EN 12211:2016), class E1350 (EN 1027:2016) and class 4 (EN 1026:2016).

ph2570.title: Passive House certificate 2570ws04
ph2570.specimen: EV HYBRID window system, component 2570ws04, manufacturer EVEREST, Tirana. Warm, temperate climate. Efficiency class phB.
ph2570.criteria: UW = 1.00 W/(m²K) (limit 1.00) with Ug = 0.90 W/(m²K), for the 2.46 m × 1.48 m test window. Installed UW limit: 1.05 W/(m²K). Hygiene criterion as printed: fRsi=0.25 ≥ 0.65. Q100 = 0.15 m³/(h·m), limit 0.25 m³/(h·m).
